paper_title: First results from a hidden photon dark matter search in the meV sector using a plane-parabolic mirror system
notes: First results from a hidden photon dark matter search using a plane-parabolic mirror system in the meV mass region. The paper reports an upper limit χ ≲ 10^-8 for the mass range 0.67–0.92 meV at 90% confidence level. The limit is derived from a broadband dish antenna search using mm-wave heterodyne detection. The local DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm³ is explicitly stated in footnote 2 and used in Eq. (1.2) for the kinetic mixing calculation. The paper assumes virialized (Maxwellian) DM velocity distribution for the main result. Both virialized (four-bin) and unvirialized (single-bin) analyses are presented, with the virialized result being the primary limit. The mass range is encoded as a horizontal line at χ = 10^-8 spanning the stated validity range (0.67–0.92 meV converted to eV). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.92, 2))
